scripts.check:inference-core: node infra/firecrawl/validate-profile.mjs && node infra/observability/validate-profile.mjs && node infra/storage/validate-profile.mjs
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @llm-machines/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @llm-machines/copy build && corepack pnpm --filter @llm-machines/web dev
